topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't believe it, I just found out about Mr. Thompson next door. All this time, I thought he was just this quiet, normal guy who kept to himself. But turns out, he's been living like a hermit with millions stashed away! I mean, really, why hide it? It’s not like it helps anyone. I know it’s none of my business, but it feels so weird. We’ve all been struggling, talking about budgets and cuts, and he’s been there, nodding along with us. I just... I don’t get it. It’s like he’s living in this weird little world of his own, and it makes you wonder what else we don’t know about the people around us.
